classification_rules.invalid: Bad source/prereg/input SHA; future-label leakage, changed cohorts, missing controls, incorrect validation, unverified raw source, runner failures, or breached single-scored-run constraint.
classification_rules.mixed: Any improvement with failed full composite, label DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO and preserve mixed notes, no promotion.
classification_rules.negative: Verified run failing one or more composite criteria (DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO), no post-result tuning.
classification_rules.supported: All six frozen go_checks true: retrieval>=uniform+6 exact, retrieval>=global episodic+4 exact, retrieval false<=uniform false, zero foreign/null accepted, retrieval>random8 exact, heldout accuracy>=uniform+0.005. External-development GO only, not native scientific acceptance.

frozen_design.capacity: 16 Boolean two-cause truth tables, 35% observation flip noise, 52 stationary historical training episodes, 8 nearest neighbors; 50% uniform smoothing; 90% posterior minimum, validation binomial p>.01.
frozen_design.compute_budget: One deterministic local CPU evaluation (3 seeds x 80 worlds x 7 arms), zero hyperparameter searches, all arms matched 144 fitting observations and 288 validation observations; no paid API.
frozen_design.data_budget: 3*80*144 fitting and 3*80*288 validation probes, plus fixed 80-world previously measured historical training archive; no other observations.
frozen_design.evaluator: Accepted exact stationary truth tables / 156; false constructions / 240; accepted foreign/null; heldout prediction accuracy / 69120; all arms evaluated identically except conventional Bayesian acceptance threshold mismatch; record CPU process time and historical memory-acquisition cost.
frozen_design.ordering: Shuffle world type assignment once per seed; fitting actions balanced in randomized blocks; first 36 only for retrieval; all 144 for fit; 288 fresh validation observations for evaluation. Seeds fixed.
frozen_design.split: Historical LR-92AB 80-world raw archive is TRAIN ONLY. 52 stationary historical episodes; new prospective independent 80-world test cohort per seed; frozen 144-fitting and 288-heldout validation probes/world. No test-world observations feed historical memory.

hypothesis: A frozen eight-neighbor likelihood-free episodic prior with 50% uniform smoothing will improve exact stationary accepted mechanisms by at least six versus uniform and four versus global episodic prior, without more false constructions.
mechanism: For each historical stationary LR-92AB world, store first36 action-wise outcome rates and uniform-Bayesian posterior after its 144 fitting probes. At test-world fit36, select eight nearest memories by four-dimensional Euclidean distance with stable tie order. Candidate prior=50% uniform + 50% mean matched episode posteriors; posterior fit uses full 144 probes. Baselines uniform, pooled historical posterior, old global prior, 8 random neighbors with independently frozen RNG, and CART/RF16.
metrics: accepted exact mechanisms on 156 stationary worlds
preregistration_note: Commit this prereg before running primary; this is an isolated external synthetic cohort, not native Yggdrasil training.
question: Does matching previously learned causal episodes to the first 36 observations improve accepted exact mechanism identification in new worlds beyond a uniform or global memory prior?
